checks.name: Customer Primary Key Uniqueness
checks.details: All customer records must have distinct unique UUIDs.

checks.name: Account Customer Reference Integrity
checks.details: Every account must link to a valid existing customer ID.

checks.name: Transaction Account Reference Integrity
checks.details: Every transaction must reference an existing account record.

checks.name: Business Identifier Pattern Conformity
checks.details: Customer business IDs must strictly adhere to CUS-XXXXXX format.

checks.name: Transaction Signed Amount Invariant
checks.details: Debit transactions must have signed_amount = -amount; credit must have signed_amount = amount.

checks.name: Unauthorized Overdraft Negative Balance Check
checks.details: Accounts without authorized overdraft facility must never drop below 0.00 balance.

checks.name: Inter-Account Transfer Legs Parity
checks.details: Debit leg of a paired transfer must match the credit leg in amount and currency.

checks.name: Positive Transaction Nominal Value
checks.details: Nominal transaction amounts must be strictly positive values.

checks.name: Transaction Timestamp Post-Account Creation
checks.details: No transaction can occur prior to the opening timestamp of its target account.

checks.name: Terminated Account Inactivity Verification
checks.details: Closed accounts cannot post subsequent financial transactions.

checks.name: Case Investigation Chronology Verification
checks.details: Case resolution and closure timestamps must follow opened timestamp sequentially.

checks.name: No Future-Dated Event Ingestion
checks.details: Events and transactions must not contain timestamps in the future.

checks.name: Alert Account Association Integrity
checks.details: Every alert must be associated with a valid account record.

checks.name: Risk Score Bounded Range Compliance
checks.details: Aggregate alert risk score must fall strictly within the interval [0, 100].

checks.name: Case Severity Classification Integrity
checks.details: Case severity must use standardized domain enums (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

checks.name: Alert Idempotency & Deduplication Invariant
checks.details: Alert deduplication keys must prevent multiple duplicate triggers for the same event.

checks.name: Customer Generation Volume Target
checks.details: Current dataset contains 500 generated customers.

checks.name: Multi-Account Distribution Factor
checks.details: Current accounts-to-customer ratio is 1.40.

checks.name: Transaction Feed Density Benchmark
checks.details: Total transactions generated: 5000.

checks.name: Alert Generation Selectivity Rate
checks.details: Alert selectivity: 15.06% of processed transactions.
